reopened_reason: Corrected EW-RS-077 mechanical partition refinement fixes the plus/minus coupling frontier without changing the 125-point scalar audit.

new_assertions.body: C sign direction is common-redundant. On the realized C presence alphabet, TOTAL, ABS_NET, and UNORDERED_PAIR are partition-equivalent and form the coarsest exact C quotient; this is the active-sign-support cardinality 0/1/2.

D/A sign direction is relocatable but jointly necessary: every common-exact point retains SIGNED_NET or SEPARATED in at least one of D or A, while neither D nor A is individually forced to retain direction.
The partition-level D/A Pareto frontier has four incomparable classes: TOTAL+SIGNED_NET, SIGNED_NET+TOTAL/UNORDERED, ABS_NET+SEPARATED, and SEPARATED+ABS_NET.
The mechanically corrected verifier reports fifteen Pareto-minimal mode-label points, but outcome-independent mode equivalence collapses them to four structural Pareto classes.

6x3-k3 is non-discriminating for RS-077 with all 125 candidates exact; 4x5-k4 accepts 80; horizontal-only 6x3-k4 accepts exactly the 65 common-exact candidates and therefore determines the current transfer set.
The four Pareto structural classes preserve scalar image dimensions 1,2,2 while their representatives reduce structural rank to 72 on 6x3-k3, 250-252 on 4x5-k4, and 13 on 6x3-k4.
Saturated-source arithmetic is set-valued: 1+,2+,3+ represent exact-count intervals. TOTAL, SIGNED_NET, and ABS_NET must operate on those sets rather than on lower-bound numerals.
A has a structural mode alias TOTAL=UNORDERED_PAIR on its frozen 0/1/2+ source alphabet, while D has no mode equivalences under its frozen 0/1/2/3+ alphabet.
Information containment and Pareto dominance for RS-077 are now mechanically derivable from frozen source alphabets and coupling maps; scalar outcomes play no role in the classification.
Independent per-family minimization is not sound for D and A because exactness is relational across their joint pair state. The next lawful reduction must treat D/A jointly.

The common exact set requires directional information somewhere in D/A, but the location and representation of that direction can vary across the four Pareto classes. This points to a relational circuit quantity rather than a privileged absolute sign channel.
EW-RS-059 remains sealed because RS-077 fixes only a structural sign-coupling quotient and does not freeze a closed scalar syndrome.
